dossier.claim: Concrete bodily descriptions and restrictive psychological properties sometimes become broad danger, damage, happiness, or difficulty. The loss is in the specified feature, not necessarily in the whole scene’s emotional effect.
dossier.sourcePattern: The Japanese identifies irreversibility, a warped way of being, a binding ideal, deliverance through rescuing someone, an unconscious self-imposed taboo, destruction into flesh, internal collapse, and the extent of an arm wound.
dossier.englishEffect: Beyond-repair damage becomes being really hurt; a warped person becomes a complicated one; and Kiritsugu’s own sense of being saved becomes gladness. A self that forbids speech becomes an unspecified something. Graphic shape and extent become fatal destruction or a big wound, while impending shredded collapse becomes slow withering.
dossier.limits: Understatement, idiomatic compression, and a broader word can preserve the intended function. Rin’s threatening complicate things is not treated as mere mild inconvenience when the exchange explicitly identifies blackmail and a prospective fight. Source vagueness should also remain vague; the counterexamples preserve both an unspecified object and an explicit catastrophic injury.
